mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation (initiator_id, expert_id, store_name, store_intro, store_address, phone, remark, status, reject_reason) VALUES (#{initiatorId}, #{expertId}, #{storeName}, #{storeIntro}, #{storeAddress}, #{phone}, #{remark}, 0, NULL)
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM reservation rv JOIN `user` iu ON rv.initiator_id = iu.id JOIN `user` eu ON rv.expert_id = eu.id WHERE (#{initiatorId} IS NOT NULL AND rv.initiator_id = #{initiatorId}) OR (#{expertId} IS NOT NULL AND rv.expert_id = #{expertId}) ORDER BY rv.id DESC

SELECT
